description: Update fields on a live published (OPEN) OpenTrain job. The revised listing is re-checked by moderation inline; if it is blocked, the job is automatically unpublished back to draft and the response explains what to fix. For unpublished drafts use opentrain_update_job_draft_fields instead. Requires jobs:write scope and the job-publishing feature.

jobId.description: Published (OPEN) OpenTrain job id to update.

patch.description: Job field patch keyed by OpenTrain field names, same shape as opentrain_update_job_draft_fields (e.g. {"jobTitle":"...","pricePerHour":14}). The revised listing is re-checked by moderation.

name: opentrain_update_published_job
